# Rule catalog

Rule sets are CEL over `f` (features, doubles) and `event` (transaction fields, enums by name). Evaluated by the Java scoring core and re-evaluated by `realy verify` for parity. Precedence: DECLINE rule > ALLOW rule > score >= decline > REVIEW rule > score >= review > APPROVE.

## `baseline` - version `baseline-v2`

Model thresholds: review >= `0.55`, decline >= `0.9`.

| Rule | Action | When | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CARD_TESTING` | DECLINE | `f.card_small_cnp_count_10m >= 3.0` | >=3 small card-not-present authorisations on the card in 10 minutes |
| `CARD_TESTING_MERCHANT` | REVIEW | `f.merch_small_cnp_count_5m >= 25.0 && event.amount_usd_minor < 200` | merchant is receiving a burst of small CNP authorisations |
| `VELOCITY_CARD_5M` | REVIEW | `f.card_count_5m > 6.0` | more than 6 transactions on the card in 5 minutes |
| `VELOCITY_CARD_10M_DISTINCT` | REVIEW | `f.card_distinct_merchants_10m >= 5.0` | card used at 5+ distinct merchants in 10 minutes |
| `IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL` | DECLINE | `event.card_present && f.card_geo_speed_kmh > 900.0` | card-present transactions implying travel faster than 900 km/h |
| `MAGSTRIPE_FOREIGN` | REVIEW | `event.entry_mode == 'MAGSTRIPE' && f.is_foreign > 0.5` | magstripe fallback abroad (counterfeit indicator) |
| `CONTACTLESS_SPLIT` | REVIEW | `f.card_contactless_count_30m >= 4.0 && f.card_contactless_sum_30m > 20000.0` | repeated contactless payments just under the CVM limit |
| `ATO_NEW_DEVICE_HIGH_AMOUNT` | REVIEW | `f.cust_device_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 300.0 && f.is_cnp > 0.5` | high-value remote purchase from a device never seen for this customer |
| `ATO_NEW_DEVICE_NEW_COUNTRY` | REVIEW | `f.cust_device_novel > 0.5 && f.cust_ip_country_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 100.0` | new device and new IP country with a material amount |
| `ATM_VELOCITY` | DECLINE | `f.card_atm_count_1h >= 3.0` | 3+ ATM withdrawals on the card within an hour |
| `ATM_TERMINAL_CASHOUT` | REVIEW | `f.is_atm > 0.5 && f.term_atm_sum_1h > 500000.0` | terminal dispensed > $5,000 within an hour |
| `APP_SCAM_NEW_PAYEE` | REVIEW | `f.is_transfer > 0.5 && f.cust_payee_novel > 0.5 && f.amount_usd > 1000.0` | large transfer to a payee never paid before |
| `MULE_FAN_IN` | DECLINE | `f.is_transfer > 0.5 && f.payee_distinct_senders_24h >= 6.0` | payee received transfers from 6+ distinct senders in 24h (mule pattern) |
| `BOT_DEVICE_MANY_CARDS` | DECLINE | `f.dev_distinct_cards_1h >= 4.0` | device used with 4+ distinct cards in an hour |
| `BUST_OUT_UTILISATION` | REVIEW | `f.credit_utilisation_24h > 0.8 && f.amount_to_avg_ratio > 8.0` | credit line nearly exhausted in 24h with outsized ticket |
